info.title: OSPulse
info.description: OSPulse — free, no-account CLI SBOM scanner. Walks a local repository, emits a CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM, and produces an exploitation-first risk read from public CISA KEV + OSV intelligence. Offline-capable. Detection and drafts only — it does not make you compliant.
